module.name: Selecciones nacionales del mundo
module.description: Paquete opcional con selecciones nacionales de las asociaciones FIFA y, cuando corresponda, territorios aprobados por separado.

scope.include_youth_teams: Solo cuando se publiquen como contenido separado y verificado
scope.include_womens_teams: Preparado para paquetes separados; no asumir plantillas ni derechos

explain_benefits: Mayor variedad de rivales y calendario internacional

availability.note: The 211-association directory and six confederation assignments are verified. National team rosters have not been built. Club roster completeness, official call-ups, eligibility checks and reuse rights remain required before any national squad package is published.

package_catalog_policy: Only package records with content_status=published, downloadable=true, HTTPS download_url and SHA-256 may be offered for installation.

roster_build_sequence.source_pool: Reuse the canonical player entities and club registrations already imported into the global player database; do not create separate duplicate player identities for national teams.
roster_build_sequence.selection_rule: A player is included in a national team squad only when an official federation call-up or equivalent authoritative competition roster explicitly lists the player for that association and window/season.
roster_build_sequence.eligibility_rule: Nationality alone is insufficient. Check FIFA eligibility, association switch/approval where applicable, and source-backed eligibility before assigning national-team association.
roster_build_sequence.fallback_rule: If a club player has no verified national-team call-up, keep the player in the global player pool and do not auto-select them for a national team.
roster_build_sequence.identity_rule: Use one stable global player_id shared by club registration and national_team_callup records.
